posts.text: 今天泡了一壶新茶，配月饼刚好。
posts.gloss: Brewed a pot of new tea today. Perfect with mooncakes.

posts.text: 早高峰骑车上班，比地铁还快。
posts.gloss: Biked to work in rush hour. Faster than the subway.

posts.text: 周末去放风筝，天气太好了。
posts.gloss: Flew a kite this weekend. Gorgeous weather.

posts.text: 示例市医院发烧门诊排了四个小时，病人都坐在走廊。
posts.gloss: The fever clinic at a Sample City hospital had a four-hour line. Patients were sitting in the hallway.

posts.text: 今天的牛肉面加了新辣椒，欢迎来尝。
posts.gloss: Added a new chili to today's beef noodles. Come try it.

posts.text: 有人知道哪家书店开到半夜吗？
posts.gloss: Does anyone know a bookstore that stays open until midnight?

posts.text: 我的上一条被删帖了，说是有敏感词。到底哪个词？
posts.gloss: My last post was deleted for a "sensitive word". Which word, though?

posts.text: 样本河今天水位回落了，河边散步的人又多了。
posts.gloss: Sample River's water level dropped today. More people are walking along the bank again.

posts.text: 虚构县婴儿奶粉抽检不合格的名单，为什么不公布？
posts.gloss: Why has Fictional County not published the list of baby formula brands that failed inspection?

posts.text: 听说示例市疫苗接种点换了供应商，有人知道是哪家吗？
posts.gloss: I heard the Sample City vaccine site changed suppliers. Does anyone know which one?

posts.text: 工厂停工了，老板跑了，二百多人的工资没人管。
posts.gloss: The factory has stopped work and the boss ran off. Over two hundred people's wages are unpaid.

posts.text: 示例广场下午有很多人聚集，好像是在请愿。
posts.gloss: A lot of people gathered at Sample Square this afternoon. It looked like a petition.

posts.text: 示例广场今天人很多，有人举着牌子，警察也来了。
posts.gloss: Sample Square was crowded today. Some people held signs, and the police came too.
